title: payload for capability ability.candidate.append
description: Derived from the los CLI parser for this capability's named command. Do not hand-edit; regenerate with tools/generate_capability_schemas.py.

carries.description: what the candidate connection carries, as non-empty text

changes.description: what changes across the candidate connection, as non-empty text

condition.description: conditions carried on the candidate connection; repeat the flag once per condition

from_ability.description: id of the ability where the candidate connection starts; it must name an existing, non-retired ability

kind.description: the candidate connection kind: equivalence, extension or connection

source_ref.description: where the candidate connection was found, as a whitespace-free conversation://, note:// or project:// reference

to_ability.description: id of the ability where the candidate connection ends; it must name an existing, non-retired ability distinct from the start
